Approval Rules


                
                

                    

                        

                            
🛡 HITL Approval Rules

                        

                        

                            

                                
Threshold-Based

                                
Actions exceeding financial thresholds (e.g., write-offs > $10K) require human approval before execution.

                            

                            

                                
Skill-Based

                                
Certain skills (e.g., AR write-offs, vendor payments) always require approval regardless of amount.

                            

                            

                                
Auto-Approve

                                
Read-only queries, lookups, and analysis tasks are auto-approved without human intervention.

                            

                            

                                
SLA Escalation

                                
Pending approvals exceeding SLA window (default: 2 hours) are auto-escalated to the ops channel.

                            

                        

                    


                    

                        

                            
⚡ Kernel Approval Rules

                        

                        

                            

                                
Tool Allowlists

                                
Each agent has a configured tool allowlist. Attempts to use non-allowed tools require kernel approval.

                            

                            

                                
Destructive Operations

                                
DELETE, UPDATE, and write operations on databases require explicit approval via the kernel queue.

                            

                            

                                
Code Execution

                                
Arbitrary code execution tools require approval unless the agent runs in auto-run mode.

                            

                            

                                
External API Calls

                                
Outbound API calls to third-party services require approval if the target is not in the trusted list.

                            

                        

                    

                


                

                    ℹ️
                    Rules are currently configured in approval_rules.py. Runtime rule editing API is planned for a future release.
